pictures.author: Jerzy Strzelecki
pictures.observed: Inspected full courtyard/prayer-hall exterior:long lead-grey pitched hall roofs flank a taller gabled transept with large green/gold mosaic face,three lower arched entries,three upper arched lights and round gable fields. Octagonal Eagle drum has paired pointed lights below a ribbed grey cap/finial. Hall has large lower arched wood/glass bays and smaller upper arched windows. A minaret projects behind the roof. Courtyard gallery has two tiers of round arches;central fountain pavilion has lower stone columns,upper open wooden gallery and pitched lead roof. Hidden plans/current finish not established.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Inspected northeast courtyard view:prayer hall/mosaic gable on south side,stacked open gallery arches on west/north sides,bright marble court,central two-level wood/stone fountain pavilion and raised octagonal Treasury on slender columns under shallow lead dome. The ornate western minaret has stacked faceted balconies/neck and pointed finial;Clock pavilion columns crop the near left edge. Photographic pavilion placement is approximate;people,loose stone remnants,fixtures and current finish excluded.

pictures.author: James Gordon
pictures.observed: Inspected full portrait through an arcade:Clock pavilion is an open ring of slender stone columns with broad octagonal entablature and ribbed shallow lead dome/finial. Behind it the north Bride minaret has a square arched-light stage and wide dark overhanging canopy below a slender upper ornamented shaft/pavilion and finial. Upper gallery has paired small round openings over larger lower arches. Fine carved capitals,clock devices/lettering and hidden profiles remain estimated or abstracted.
